sn35.60:1.4: cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso
sn35.60:1.6: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati rūpesupi nibbindati cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati vedanāyapi nibbindati
sn35.60:1.7: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimokkhapariññātaṃ me upādānanti pajānāti.
sn35.60:1.12: manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso
sn35.60:1.14: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako manasmiṃpi nibbindati dhammesupi nibbindati manoviññāṇepi nibbindati manosamphassepi nibbindati vedanāyapi nibbindati
sn35.60:1.15: nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati vimokkhapariññātaṃ me upādānanti pajānāti.
